question: A trader sells an item for Rs. 516.60 after offering a discount of 18% on its list price. Had he not given the discount, he would have earned a profit of 26%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the item?
solution:

CP = MP × 100over(100+G), where

MP = Marked Price

G = Gain%
